archetype.gift: warmth, disparity, and the colour of souls
archetype.waning: the Ember gutters; shadows lengthen and the dead forget to lie down
archetype.curse_desc: a grey brand that spreads over the heart; the marked wander until their names burn out
mysteries: The Ember is not dying — the gods siphon it to prolong their reign, and the curse is the siphon's residue.
The Ember was stolen, not given; its true keeper still waits below the world, and every rekindling deepens the debt.
The first soul ever kindled was unwilling, and the Ember remembers; the curse is its slow act of accounting.

mystery: The Ember is not dying — the gods siphon it to prolong their reign, and the curse is the siphon's residue.

ages.name: the Age of the Gift
ages.blurb: the First Ember gave the world warmth, disparity, and the colour of souls.

ages.name: the Age of Names
ages.blurb: The gods withdrew to their high seats and mortals learned to matter. Then the waning began: the Ember gutters; shadows lengthen and the dead forget to lie down.

ages.name: the Age of Dusk
ages.blurb: The present age. The gods are silent, the roads belong to the marked, and pilgrims walk toward rumours of a cure.

events.text: the First Ember rose (or was raised — the tellings differ) and gave the world warmth, disparity, and the colour of souls.
Aldranara, god of storms and unkept promises, claimed a portion of the gift and took a throne.
Tormund, god of healing and the price of healing, claimed a portion of the gift and took a throne.
Ghalanorn, god of graves and the ledger of names, claimed a portion of the gift and took a throne.
Hestamoth, god of secrets, locks, and the spaces between, claimed a portion of the gift and took a throne.
Aldranara founded Nimiulacradle (church) at Osthildfen.
The Ash of Aldranara was wrought as regalia of Aldranara's throne.
Tormund founded Sylivethvault (kingdom) at Ruthiamothgate.
The Cinder of Tormund was wrought as regalia of Tormund's throne.
Ghalanorn founded Ysottdeep (kingdom) at Harusilamarch.
The Ash of Ghalanorn was wrought as regalia of Ghalanorn's throne.
Hestamoth founded Ruthgrimbarrow (kingdom) at Aldriarionreach.
The Brand of Hestamoth was wrought as regalia of Hestamoth's throne.
Hareast, the Cinder-Eater, rose against the thrones. Tormund led the gods to war.
events.hidden: Aldranara treated with Hareast in secret and was spared what followed.

events.text: Hareast was defeated and sealed beneath Queldrashroud; the seal was bought with the lives of 9 champions.

The waning began: the Ember gutters; shadows lengthen and the dead forget to lie down. Mortals called the affliction the Gutter-mark: a grey brand that spreads over the heart; the marked wander until their names burn out.
Morenric the Forsworn founded the Order of the Ash at Karenvanehollow, sworn to stand against the Gutter-mark.
The Church of Ghalanorn was raised at Kadishold; Hesteyne of the Long Vigil took its first pulpit, preaching that the waning is a trial and the faithful will be spared.
Omirorn the Twice-crowned was cast out of Church of Ghalanorn and founded the Cult of the Patient Below, teaching that the gods themselves caused the waning.
events.hidden: The heresy is nearer the truth than the sermon.

events.text: Quelnoth the Unbowed united the river-clans and was crowned in Banudanespire; the realm took the name Cyrvanecradle.
At the urging of Hesteyne, the saint Morric the Adamant was given to the First Ember in the rite of restoration. For a generation, the waning slowed.
events.hidden: The rite did not restore anything. It only fed the waning more slowly — and Hesteyne suspected as much.

events.text: Omthas of the Long Vigil, sword-hand of Quelnoth, opened the gates of Banudanespire to the Order of the Ash over a grievance no chronicle agrees on.
events.hidden: Omthas acted on a promise from the Cult of the Patient Below: that the marked of their house would be spared the Gutter-mark. The promise was not kept.

events.text: Cyrvanecradle fell. Quelnoth the Unbowed died at the foot of their own throne; the crown was carried away and never worn again.
Omthas was found at Solucaelmarch bearing the Gutter-mark, and was not spared.
Ghalanorn, god of graves and the ledger of names, was unmade upon their own throne. No wound was found, and no successor dared the seat.
events.hidden: What unmade the god was not violence but understanding — a truth arrived at, all at once.

events.text: Wrenendane the Latecomer, last-sworn of the Order of the Ash, set out for the place where Ghalanorn was lost, carrying the order's final blessing.
Wrenendane was last seen at the edge of the deep roads. The order keeps a vigil that has not ended.
Pilgrims of the Cult of the Patient Below were found digging at the seal of Hareast. The wardens hanged nine; the digging continued.
events.hidden: The seal has been failing on its own since the waning began. The cult only follows the cracks.
